target: annual PAS_CRD on-flight airport-pair passengers, both directions, all carriers

policy.cohort: Five complete clean consecutive training years; eligibility decided before inspecting target.
policy.annual_quality: 12 distinct months; finite nonnegative passengers; no source flag; relative reporter spread <= 10%.
policy.missing: Absent, incomplete and quality-rejected targets are unscored, never zero or interpolated.
policy.time: origin is end of decision year; lag=1 only uses annual data through origin-1; lag=0 is an optimistic sensitivity.
policy.vintage: Archive with latest revisions; dates of actual historical publication are not reconstructed.
policy.selection_bias: Scores are conditional on an observable complete target. Unobserved exits/entries are not evaluated.
policy.dependence: Overlapping origin/horizon cases and repeated pairs are not independent samples.
policy.interval: Empirical 80th percentile absolute log1p error from >=3 prior origins and >=100 cases whose targets <= current anchor. No distribution-free guarantee; same-pair and overlapping outcomes remain dependent.
policy.production_PTF: Not tested: airport catchment and historical P/T/F inputs are not yet rebuilt within each fold.
policy.incremental_factors: Income, tourism, business, diaspora and visas are not fitted in this baseline experiment.

log_trend.b: OLS slope of log1p annual passengers on five equally spaced past years

damped_log_trend.selection: fixed before scoring, not selected on final targets
